title: Cloud platform allocation
transcript:
Platform Engineering Lead: Alright, let's dive into our cloud strategy for the next fiscal year. I've been looking at various options.

SRE: I've been doing some analysis on cost savings with Google Cloud. It's a solid platform, but I'm afraid the near-term savings aren't as substantial as AWS.

Finance Partner: Agreed. The cost difference is noticeable, and we need to consider our bottom line.

Platform Engineering Lead: Exactly. On-premises infrastructure is another option, but it's strategically necessary for us to modernize and reduce maintenance costs.

CTO: I've also looked into a hybrid model with Microsoft Azure. However, our budget doesn't currently support a multi-cloud strategy.

Finance Partner: (nudging) So, it seems like AWS is our most promising option.

Platform Engineering Lead: Yes, AWS offers the lowest cost per unit for our current workloads and provides the best ecosystem integration for our existing tools and services.

CTO: (pauses) I have concerns about AWS's increasing prices and long-term implications.

Finance Partner: I share those concerns, but we can mitigate that risk by regularly reviewing our usage and negotiating contracts.

Platform Engineering Lead: That's a fair point. I'll also develop a migration plan by the end of the year to minimize service disruptions.

Finance Partner: And I'll conduct a comprehensive review of AWS services in Q2 to identify potential cost savings.

CTO: Alright, I see the merits. I'll sign off on adopting AWS as our primary cloud platform for the next fiscal year.

Platform Engineering Lead: Thanks for your input, everyone. Let's keep an eye on those potential risks and work together to make this transition a success.

(off-topic exchange)

CTO: By the way, any updates on the company picnic this year?

Platform Engineering Lead: Oh, yes! The planning committee is finalizing the details. They mentioned a beach party with volleyball and a barbecue. I think it's scheduled for mid-July.

CTO: Sounds like fun! I'll make sure to clear my calendar. Let's get back to work now.

Platform Engineering Lead: Absolutely, let's get moving!

Title: Cloud Platform Strategy for the Next Fiscal Year

Decision: The team has adopted Amazon Web Services (AWS) as the primary cloud platform for the upcoming fiscal year. This move is strategically necessary to modernize our infrastructure and reduce maintenance costs. The platform engineering lead will develop a migration plan by year-end, aiming to minimize service disruptions.
